purpose: Bind the published dMAP/CenDPI implementation-fingerprinting method to confirmed PROTEI_DPI reference deployments without performing unauthorized active measurements.

upstream_project.paper: Fingerprinting Deep Packet Inspection Devices by Their Ambiguities, CCS 2025
requirements: root privileges for raw socket access
upstream_project.measurement_model: remote black-box probes with TestDomain and ControlDomain comparisons

observed_probe_families_in_public_repo: additional malformed/parser-ambiguity probes defined by the published implementation
method_claim: The CCS 2025 work reports that 20-40 discriminative probes can distinguish DPI implementations even when different products use the same visible enforcement action such as generic TCP resets.

measurement_gate.reason: A true vendor fingerprint requires controlled active measurements or equivalent published raw results from appropriate vantage points; ordinary public blocking observations are insufficient.
measurement_gate.ethical_constraint: Use authorized/research-compliant targets and rate limits. Do not infer vendor identity from blocklists or generic RST/timeouts.

success_condition: Obtain a stable 20-40 bit ambiguity-probe vector from at least two confirmed PROTEI deployments in different countries.
Show low Hamming distance between those independent PROTEI vectors.
Show materially larger distance to same-country non-PROTEI controls and unrelated DPI implementations.
Localize the effect so a shared upstream cannot explain the match.
Only then search the global corpus for the derived PROTEI vector.
important_negative_results: MegaCom 2024 TikTok post-ClientHello timeout is not a PROTEI fingerprint because similar behavior occurred across multiple Kyrgyz ISPs.
AS43197 2019 censorship events are not a PROTEI fingerprint because the operator attributed at least one restriction to its upstream provider.
Cuba is excluded from fingerprint derivation because a stronger Huawei-family censorship fingerprint was independently identified there.
next_research_step: Search published/raw Censored Planet data and research artifacts for the confirmed PROTEI ASNs first; if no existing ambiguity-probe vectors are available, the remaining step is a controlled research measurement campaign using the public CenDPI probe battery.
claim_ceiling: WE NOW HAVE THE PUBLIC SCIENTIFIC FINGERPRINTING ENGINE AND A MULTI-COUNTRY PROTEI REFERENCE SET, BUT NOT YET THE PROTEI FINGERPRINT ITSELF.
